non_overlap_statement: The implementation worker alone edited the governed pilot files; the scout, optimizer, and independent checker were read-only, and the root foreman edited only task-local mesh evidence.

proof_obligations.description: The change extends existing DAD contracts without a duplicate runtime authority surface.
No trigger, recommendation, or pilot result can mutate active systems or self-promote.
The pilot bounds human attention, decisions, workstreams, quiet states, and expiry.

unresolved_decisions.summary: The full pytest run produced no result before the five-minute cap; changed-path suites passed and the timeout remains a nonblocking baseline unknown.
Scoped DAD validation checks 258 items but remains invalid on nine pre-existing MCP dependency-map fingerprints whose source files were untouched by this task.

reconciliations.reason: The completed inventory constrained the build to existing contracts.
The original writer completed one checker-directed repair pass without expanding write authority.
The checker remained read-only and issued the final candidate/manual release gate.
